overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating 'inferential decompositions' - sets of explicit and implicit propositions related to input text. This is an NLG task where the paper generates text (propositions) and evaluates them. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and inconsistent naming. The paper uses both automatic metrics and human evaluation, but does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators.
